editorial: Forget the romanticized myths of the frontier and prepare for a brutal lesson in greed. You will find yourself trapped in a claustrophobic expanse where the pursuit of wealth quickly spirals into a psychological nightmare. The hauntingly stark cinematography captures the sheer scale of the slaughter, making the landscape feel as predatory as the men inhabiting it. If you crave a Western that prioritizes philosophical dread over gunfights, this is your journey.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of revisionist westerns and psychological dramas.
